metadata.title: docs: refresh docs formatting, links, and diagrams
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary

- Normalize MkDocs list formatting to prevent collapsed bullets and improve readability.
- Fix internal doc links/anchors flagged by mkdocs serve (broken relative paths, missing anchors).
- Align API documentation with actual runtime ports and auth requirements (8000 dev, 4444 serve, 8080 docker‑compose via nginx; health/readiness/base URLs).
- Update Mermaid diagrams to match current code paths (OAuth UI flow, multitenancy/SSO/admin flows) and ensure diagrams render in both themes.
- Link generated architecture diagrams produced by make docs.

## Related

- Addresses DOC‑04 from #2483 (API reference accuracy: ports/auth/health/base URL alignment).
- Partially addresses #2483 overall.

## Coverage vs #2483

Addressed

- DOC‑04: API reference accuracy (ports/auth/health/base URL alignment).
- DOC‑05 (partial): Architecture diagrams current (updated Mermaid content + linked generated diagrams).
- DOC‑08 (partial): Broken links (internal links/anchors fixed from MkDocs warnings).

Not addressed

- DOC‑01: OpenAPI lint/endpoint diff.
- DOC‑02: Run/validate all curl examples end‑to‑end.
- DOC‑03: Full quickstart walkthrough validation.
- DOC‑06: CHANGELOG review.
- DOC‑07: README validation against current behavior.
- External link checker + schema response validation.
